title: Epochal retirement with traffic-bubble and KV warmup orchestrator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Implement an automated node retirement workflow that minimizes SLO impact by combining epoch-based retirement windows, transient traffic bubbles, and staged KV cache warmup. Background: Dedicated fleets occasionally require host retirement (hardware refresh, security patching, capacity rebalancing). Current draining causes long tail latency spikes for chat/generation workloads because KV caches are cold after bulk evacuations and autoscaler decisions race with drains. We need an orchestration primitive that books a retirement epoch, creates a lightweight traffic bubble (soft shadowing) to drain top-off traffic, triggers targeted KV prewarm for in-flight models, and coordinates with the autoscaler to reserve throughput lanes during the epoch.
acceptance_criteria: Able to schedule a node retirement epoch that reserves X% throughput for remaining hosts (configurable)
Traffic bubble mechanism routes 10% of new requests to retiring node for N minutes for graceful session completion without impacting 95th percentile latency on the fleet
KV prewarm triggers to a subset of nodes with model-aware key sampling and reduces cold-start tail latency by 50% in canary tests
Autoscaler integration prevents scale-down during active epochs and honors reserved throughput lanes
E2E telemetry visible in Console: per-node epoch state, prewarm progress, SLO deltas and rollback hooks
